title: Workout logging
description: Users log sets and reps for each exercise manually.

title: Daily reminder notification
description: Send a daily reminder push notification at 8am local time.

title: Saving workouts
description: Workouts are saved directly to the server; the app shows an error if there is no connection.

title: Apple Health export
description: Export completed workouts to Apple Health.

title: Email login
description: Users sign in with email and password.

title: Dark mode
description: Add a dark theme that follows the system setting.

title: Progress charts
description: Weekly training volume chart covering the last four weeks.

title: Subscription
description: Monthly subscription at $9.99 through App Store and Google Play billing.

title: Crash reporting
description: Sentry crash reporting in production builds.
